model_output.rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial on a commercial claim (CI). DOS 2025-01-19. 277CA proves payer receipt on 2025-01-27 (8 days post-DOS, status A2 accepted), same trace TRC75364521. Denial is erroneous — appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report. N211 is a Medicare remark applied in error on a commercial remit; it does not bar commercial appeal rights.

root_cause.explanation: Payer denied CO-29 (filing limit expired) but 277CA proves claim receipt 2025-01-27, only 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19. The denial is factually wrong — the claim was timely under any commercial filing limit.

next_action.detail: Appeal to Liberty Bell with the 277CA acceptance report (trace TRC75364521, received 2025-01-27, status A2) as proof of timely filing. Dispute the receipt date; do not plead forgiveness.

evidence.fact: Both lines denied CO-29 (timely filing expired), MOA N211, $0 paid
Claim TRC75364521 accepted for adjudication (A2/20) with received date 2025-01-27
DOS 2025-01-19; same trace TRC75364521 confirms identity with 277CA
Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report

citations.rule: Proof of timely receipt → appeal disputing the receipt date
N211 has been applied in error (R3118CP); commercial appeal rights are contract-driven
